faq.title: AI workspace questions for executive assistants and operations partners
faq.description: Executive assistants need speed without losing discretion, recipient awareness, decision ownership, or control over sensitive organizational context.

items.question: Is Floatboat an executive calendar or task-management system?
items.answer: No. Calendars and task systems remain the records of commitments. Floatboat helps assemble meeting context, draft briefs, recover decisions, and prepare updates across those sources.

items.question: Can it decide priorities or commit an executive's time?
items.answer: It can surface conflicts and prepare options, but the executive and authorized staff decide priorities, access, delegation, and calendar commitments.

items.question: Can it follow an executive's preferred briefing format?
items.answer: Yes. Define the expected length, sections, decision framing, confidentiality labels, source links, and what should be omitted for each audience.

items.question: How do we prevent an uncertain note from becoming a recorded decision?
items.answer: Keep proposed, discussed, and confirmed decisions separate; link entries to the meeting source; and require the responsible person to confirm ownership, wording, and due dates.

items.question: How should board, personnel, or deal context be handled?
items.answer: Follow organizational classification and need-to-know rules, isolate sensitive work where needed, and verify the processing behavior and permissions of each connected model and tool.

items.question: Can it send follow-ups or place events directly on calendars?
items.answer: It can prepare messages and proposed calendar actions, but an authorized person should confirm the recipient, commitment, timing, and visibility before execution.

items.question: What is a useful first executive-support workflow?
items.answer: Use one recurring leadership meeting. Assemble the agenda, previous decisions, current documents, and open actions into a brief, then verify it with the executive before saving the pattern.

finalCta.title: Give the repetitive preparation around executive assistants and operations partners a better workspace.
finalCta.description: Start with one recurring meeting and its real source material. Produce a brief that saves preparation time without making commitments on anyone's behalf.
